_readme: The Bridge sector: 400 x 400 m, centred on the origin, so x and y run -20000..+20000.
+Y is north (the world edge, where the extractions are), +X is east.
A ravine splits the sector east-west at y = 0 with exactly three crossings:
the pipe at x = -14000, the bridge at x = 0, the ford at x = +13000.
The near (north) half is quiet and poor; the far (south) half holds the best loot
and most of the bots, so the player must cross for the haul and cross back with it.
pos.z is the kind's own half-height, so every prop rests on the floor (top of floor = z 0).
'note' and '_readme' keys are ignored by the parser; they are here so the file reads as a plan.

blocks.note: RAVINE — north rim, y = +1800. Four segments with gaps at the pipe, the bridge and the ford. This line plus its southern twin is the map's spine; nothing else is a block.
RAVINE — south rim, y = -1800. Gaps aligned with the north rim, or a crossing would end in a wall.

RAVINE BED — the VISUAL stand-in for a 400-700 uu dig (spec §5.2), not a pit. Flat, non-colliding, 4 uu thick, sitting ON the floor: cliffs plus a dark bed plus water read identically from a top-down camera, and a real hole buys fall damage, stuck pawns and nav holes on iOS for zero gameplay. Crossability is still the eight rim walls above, exactly as before — nothing here digs, and nothing here stops anyone.

WATER — y = -700..+700 per ТЗ §5, on top of the bed (z 4..10). OPAQUE: a translucent material needs an authored asset and this project authors none (spec §5.2). Dark blue-grey on the darker bed reads as water from above; it will NOT read as water in a close-up, and the ford's 'мелкая вода' is this same tone rather than a lighter shallow. That is a shipped limitation, not a bug.

HIGHWAY (ТЗ §7). Authored under the traffic jam that already exists rather than on §7's (-1500,+20000) -> (0,0) line: the 28 wrecks, the checkpoint and the bridge approach rails were all placed on a straight x~0 centreline, and asphalt on the §7 diagonal would leave the whole jam standing in the grass — which is also what breaks the firing line (§7). So: straight from the bridge deck to y=+16500, then a westward bend toward the north edge. Roads are z 0..6, i.e. 2 uu above the ravine bed, so the two never z-fight where they meet. 1200 wide, inside §7's 900-1300.
The bend toward §7's north end. Stops at x=-600 rather than -1500 so the northernmost wrecks stay ON the asphalt.
South of the ravine the §7 line (0,0) -> (+1000,-10000) fits the existing content, so it is used verbatim: the wreck at (600,-9900) and the sandbags at y=-7200 sit on it.
The village/промзона fork at (+1000,-10000) — an east-west bar, kept north of the house at (1000,-11200) so no road runs under a building.

WEST DIRT ROAD (ТЗ §7): (-18000,+17000) -> (-15500,+11000) -> (-14500,+3000) -> pipes -> (-14500,-5000) -> АЗС. 650 wide (§7 wants 500-800) and LIGHTER than the ground (§14). This is Bridge_West's actual route, which is why it is the road that exists now; the east road, the village lanes and the ford's shallows are Stage C. Both pipe-crossing segments stop at the ravine bed's edge (y = +/-2200): the crossing itself is a walkway between pipes, not a road, and asphalt over the bed would z-fight a darker surface.
The spur along the АЗС's north face into its forecourt, so the station reads as somewhere a road goes rather than a shed in a field. Held clear of the building's north wall (y = -8250) on purpose.

THE EAST CLOSURE, north of the ravine. Bridge_West is the west third; the rest of the sector is physically closed and opens in Stage D by deleting these blocks and their dressing. A BLOCK rather than tiled treeline props because a block takes any extent and a prop does not: this is 3 actors where 15 props would be, and it carries surface 'vegetation' so it is the same colour as the treeline props that straddle it and break its straight edge. 1000 uu tall (extent.z 500), which is 5.7x the pawn — it cuts sight completely. Every joint below BUTTS: two blocks that share a face plane are separated at BlocksOverlapXY's 0.01 slack, and an overlap of one unit fails Sarko.Map.BridgeBuildingsAreEnterable.

THE EAST CLOSURE, south of the ravine, 3000 uu further west so it clears the village's own ledger footprint (ТЗ §9 puts the village at X -9000..+3500) and never cuts through the two walkable houses Stage B authored. The step between the two runs happens inside the ravine, where the rim walls already close x -13600..-1100 — so it is a step nobody can stand at.

THE WORLD BORDER, west edge. Not decoration: the floor is 40000x40000 and ends, the rail depot sits 1000 uu from its southern edge, and walking off a 400 m plane is a KillZ death with the haul in the backpack. Three pieces because the ravine's rim walls reach the map's west edge and nothing may overlap them — the middle piece closes the gorge's mouth, which IS reachable through the pipe crossing.
THE WORLD BORDER, south edge. Stops at x = -9300, which is closure_south_c's west face: east of that the border is the closure's job and a second block there would overlap it.

THE WORLD BORDER, north edge, in two pieces with a 1200 uu mouth between them at x -16100..-14900. That mouth is E1: the only gap in the treeline is the way out of the world, which is exactly what an extraction should look like from above.
THE PIPE CROSSING — concrete bases under the two pipe rows (ТЗ §6 'бетонные основания'). Flat paint, not kerbs: a colliding base at the mouth of a 420 uu walkway would make the crossing a squeeze.
The техдвор's yard, so the shed reads as a working yard rather than a hut in grass.

THE АЗС FORECOURT — this pad IS the навес. A canopy roof cannot exist here: the camera is above and ТЗ §13 says the roof must not hide the player, so the shelter is expressed as its own footprint plus the four pillars in props. Held east of x = -12900 so it does not run under the shop's east wall.
THE RAIL DEPOT — the разгрузка pad L26 stands on.

ТЗ §9's путь, at last: two rails under the freight cars that have been parked on nothing since the sector was first authored. Rust, flat, non-colliding — 20 uu half-width each, 240 uu apart, which reads as gauge from above.
The depot's approach off the west dirt road, so the siding is somewhere a road goes.

buildings.note: S01 АЗС (ТЗ §28 / §9) at its ledger coordinate. Зал + подсобка + служебная, входы В и Ю exactly as ТЗ §9 names them: east is the forecourt the pump row stands on, south is the road onward to the ж/д тупик. Two exits, because a bot in the only doorway is a coffin (ТЗ §13); no door in the west face, which is the side the west dirt road runs past — a doorway there would let anyone on that road shoot straight through the building. Replaces the solid house prop that stood in for this shop 3800 uu further north.

interiorWalls.note: зал | подсобка. The opening sits well south of where the служебная wall below meets this one, so no interior wall ever ends inside another's doorway.

buildings.note: THE PIPE CROSSING's техдвор shed (ТЗ §6 'техдвор на юге'). No §28 ledger row — §28 puts no building at the crossing, and the owner's Bridge_West list asks for a tech shed; it needs a row when the full map is authored. Two doorways because the shed is a shortcut off the crossing's south mouth, and a bot in the only doorway is a coffin (ТЗ §13). Interior 1140x840. Rust, because it belongs to the industrial vocabulary and reads apart from the timber sheds further south.

S02 сарай АЗС (ТЗ §28) at its ledger coordinate, walkable because §29's L25 is inside it. Interior 940x740; the container at (-15700,-10500) stands 270 uu off the west wall's inner face. Timber: this is the warm village tone, and the АЗС's own shop is structure grey — two materials, two readings, one camp.

The АЗС's wc — CLOSED (zero doors), which ТЗ §28 has four of and the expander explicitly allows. It is silhouette and cover on the forecourt's north edge, nothing more; no container is authored inside, and the reachability fill is skipped because there is nothing to reach. Interior 640x540, which is the smallest footprint the expander accepts with 30 uu walls.

S03 диспетчерская (ТЗ §28/§9) at its ledger coordinate, walkable, holding §29's L28. North opens onto the siding, west onto the warehouse yard — the two sides people arrive from and leave by. Interior 1040x740.

THE RAIL WAREHOUSE — no §28 ledger row (the owner's list asks for one; §9's ж/д has only the диспетчерская and a будка). The deepest room on the route and the only two-room building west of the village: the divider at local x=400 leaves a big west room and a narrow east one, and the military container sits in the west while the паллеты sit in the east, so the richest loot is the furthest from both doorways. Interior 2340x1540; the divider leaves 755 uu of clear passage to the east wall, well over ТЗ §13's 250.
The будка at the depot's west end (ТЗ §9). CLOSED, like the wc: it breaks the skyline at the end of the siding and gives the bot at (-16000,-16500) something to stand behind.

S04 D1 (ТЗ §28 / §9), проходим. A through-house at the west end of the village: north opens onto the village street and the run down from the bridge, which is where everyone arrives from; south opens onto the lane toward the scrap yard and the rail siding, which is where everyone is going. The two doorways are in different rooms on purpose — crossing the divider is the price of using the house as a shortcut. Replaces the westernmost solid village house.

S05 D2 (ТЗ §28 / §9), проходим, 2 good. One room, two exits — the simplest walkable shape, kept simple on purpose so the three buildings cover a range. North faces the street between the two village rows, east faces the lane to the highway fork; both are sides people actually walk past. Replaces the solid house prop 707 uu away whose footprint this building sits on.

ТЗ §15's техстроения, 1 of 2. CLOSED: this is a large form to break 140 m of empty field and to give the walk from the spawn to the pipes something to navigate by, not a room. Interior 840x640 with the default 30 uu walls, which clears the expander's 500 uu floor on both axes. Zero doorways is legal and deliberate (ТЗ §13: two exits or none) — a building nobody enters costs four walls and buys a silhouette.

ТЗ §15's техстроения, 2 of 2, on the ground ТЗ §8's дачи will one day occupy — N01-N03 are Stage D (the owner's Bridge_West list does not include them), so §15's fill holds this cell until then. Rust, so the two sheds do not read as a matched pair. Also CLOSED.

props.note: THE BRIDGE — deck, three lanes (1800 uu of roadway) spanning the whole 3600 uu ravine and running 900 uu onto each bank. Sunk to a 40 uu lip so the pawn steps onto it instead of being stopped by it. Two lanes read as a footbridge from above; the main crossing has to be unmistakable.
THE BRIDGE — parapets. They make it read as a bridge from above and are the only cover you get while crossing.
THE BRIDGE — approach rails north and south. They funnel the run-up and, from above, are what turns a gap in the cliff into an obvious road crossing.

THE BRIDGE — four pylons, one at each corner of the two mouths. From the overview they mark the crossing; at the player's camera they are the only thing tall enough to say 'bridge' before you are on it, since the deck and the parapets are the same grey as the ground.
THE PIPE CROSSING (west) — a 420 uu walkway between two rows of standing pipes. Single file, and the pipes are tall enough to be a landmark from the north half.
THE FORD (east, x 12000..14000) has no props at all, on purpose: it is 2000 uu of open ground. Its cost is being seen.
THE HIGHWAY — a broken traffic jam from the north edge down to the bridge, in clusters of two or three with gaps: cover you can move along, with holes in it.
THE JUNCTION — the east-west road the highway comes off, so the jam reads as traffic and not as a fence.
SPAWN (north-west) — a broken fence with gaps, and junk to pick up. Nothing here is worth dying for, which is the point.
Moved 400 west and 500 south of where it was authored: ТЗ §8's spawn 03 at (-15000,+17000) stood inside this wreck's footprint. It is now L03's остов.

BUS STOP — a landmark on the way east, and the first real cover after spawn. The bus, its shelter wall and the crate beside it moved 700-800 uu west when the east closure was authored: at x -6200 the bus's 1200 uu body ran straight through the barrier block at x -6300..-5900, and the crate stood 100 uu inside it. At -6900 the bus ends exactly at the barrier's west face and reads as a bus parked against the treeline, which is also the closure's story at this road.

The shelter's west end, moved 700 uu west with the bus. Not in the closure plan's list of four, but the bus's body is 1200 uu long: once the bus stands at -6900 its west face is at -7500 and this wall's old x -7160..-7040 is INSIDE it. It keeps its original 240 uu gap to the bus's west face.
Moved 700 uu west with the shelter wall it stands against — at x -6800 the wall's new footprint (-7300..-6500) swallowed it.
CHECKPOINT — two staggered sandbag lines north of the bridge, so the approach is a weave rather than a straight run. First military loot, first real decision.
RUINS (east edge, near half) — the only reason to go east before crossing, and the one bot in the near half lives here.

THE АЗС FORECOURT, re-authored around the shop's ТЗ §28 coordinate. The pumps stood 3900 uu north of their own shop from the moment the shop moved, which read as a station with no fuel; they are now a row of three on the canopy pad, east of the shop's east doorway, exactly where a car would pull in. ТЗ §9 wants 3-4.
The canopy's four pillars — see bridge_gas_canopy_pad. A pipe is a 1200 uu cylinder, which is what a canopy stanchion looks like from above and the only upright the kind table has.

THE ВЫВЕСКА (ТЗ §14 lists it as a landmark). A mast with a sign at its foot: the road_sign kind is a 170 uu plate at 320 uu, which is signage rather than a landmark, and a landmark-scale plate needs a composite kind this stage does not add. Flagged, not silently dropped.

L24's фургон. Composite: pos.z = 0. Yaw 0 rather than the 90 first drafted: turned across the road its 700 uu body swallowed L24 at (-15000,-7600) whole, and a container inside a solid prop is loot nobody can reach. Lengthways it stands 230 uu clear of the container, which is the van you loot from.
Cover on the forecourt, so crossing it is not a free walk with two bots watching.

VILLAGE — four solid houses in two staggered rows, plus the two walkable ones in "buildings" (D1 at the west end, D2 in the southern row). The 1600 uu gaps between them are the fighting lanes, and the stagger stops any lane running clean through the village.
Shifted 500 uu west of where it was authored: at x -2800 this fence overlapped bridge_village_d2's west wall by a 30 x 120 uu sliver.

Shifted 150 uu west of where it was authored: at x -2600 this crate was half-buried in bridge_village_d2's west wall. It now stands against the outside of it, which is where a crate by a house belongs.
RAIL SIDING (far half, south-west) — a stopped train. Long hard cover along one axis and nothing along the other, which makes approaching it a choice.

Moved 800 uu west of where it was authored: at yaw 25 this car's footprint reaches x -8502, straight through the east closure's southern run at x -9300..-8900. At -10000 its east corner stops 698 uu short of the barrier's west face.
WATER TOWER — the landmark. 1400 uu tall, visible from the whole far half and from the bridge; it replaces the minimap.
INDUSTRIAL YARD (far corner) — best loot, most bots, and a sandbagged entrance so it cannot be walked into casually.

FARMSTEAD (near half, west) — the only landmark in the quiet north-west. Not in the spec's POI list: without it there is 200 m of featureless ground between the spawn and the pipe crossing and nothing to navigate by.
SCRAP YARD (far half, west-centre) — fills the ground between the village and the rail siding, and gives the pipe crossing somewhere to lead.
FARM COMPOUND (far half, east-centre) — between the water tower and the industrial yard, on the route back from the ford.
CEMENT WORKS (far half, west edge) — silos and two sheds. Fills 150 m of empty west bank and gives the pipe crossing somewhere to lead once you are across.
THE FIELD (far half, south of the village) — an old fight nobody cleared up. Broken cover in the open, so crossing the southern flats is not a free run.
SOUTHERN HOMESTEAD (far half, south-centre-east) — the last thing before the south edge, where the neighbouring sector will open.

FIRST LIGHT FOR THE NEW KINDS. One of each of Stage B's nine, at the collapsed junction road where the east closure crosses it. Nothing placed these kinds before, so their extents and colours had never been seen in a frame; they are photographed here before the north fill authors a hundred and forty. Each one stays as real content afterwards. Two conventions: a single-box kind carries its own half-height in pos.z, a COMPOSITE carries 0 because each part carries its own height.

Composite: pos.z = 0, the parts carry the height. Yaw 90 turns the plate's face west, into the player walking east along the junction. Placed on the open shoulder south of the bus stop rather than at (-6800,16400): the bus's 1200 uu body now stands at -6900 and would have swallowed post and plate whole.

West of the log rather than east of it: at (-6350,+15300) 85 uu of the bush stood inside the barrier block, and a bush is 90 uu tall against a 1000 uu wall of foliage — half of it would simply not be there.

ЛЭП pylon #3 of the three in the active north, on ТЗ §8's line (-11000,+19000) -> (+4000,+8500): at x = -8200 that line is at y = 17040. The other two are the north fill's. Authored 1400 uu further west along the same line than first drafted — at (-6800,+16060) both of its legs stood INSIDE the treeline prop above, which is 1200 x 400 uu, and a pylon whose legs are buried in a wall of foliage is a pylon nobody can read. Yaw 55, not 0: the crossarms have to sit PERPENDICULAR to the line the wires run along (the §8 line bears -35 degrees), and the same yaw turns the two legs — which are offset along the kind's local X — off the player's east-west axis, so both are visible instead of one hiding the other.

TREELINE, north run — the silhouette. The barrier block does the blocking; these break its edge and give the player something with depth to read at eye level. Varied x by +/-100 and yaw by a few degrees on purpose: a line of identical boxes reads as a fence. Each one is 1200 x 400 uu, so at x -6400 it straddles the block at -6300..-5900 and hides its straight face.

TREELINE, south run. The clump at y -16200 was moved to -17300 and one added at -15300: at -16200 it stood inside the jack-knifed freight car's new footprint, and without the extra the run had a 3900 uu stretch of bare barrier face.

THE COLLAPSED JUNCTION ROAD (north) — the closure needs a cause, not just a wall. Three jersey barriers butted end to end across the carriageway 120 uu short of the barrier's west face, a wreck shoved onto the shoulder, and the bus stop beside them. Authored at x -6420 rather than -6500: at -6500 each barrier's west end clipped the bus shelter's wall, which moved 700 uu west with the bus.
Shoved onto the north shoulder beside the trailer. Not at (-6700,+16900): that point is inside both the bus shelter's wall and the crate against it.

THE COLLAPSED SOUTH ROAD — the same story on the southern run, where the village lane used to come through. The two barriers butt at y -11250; the wreck sits 500 uu west of them and the sign 900 uu north, both clear of the treeline clump at (-9600,-10600), which the first draft buried them in.
SCATTER along both runs, so the treeline has an understorey rather than a hem. The southern bush moved from y -15000 to -12200 to stay out of the added treeline clump.

ТЗ §15 FILL OF THE NORTH begins here. The complaint it answers is measurable: 89 props north of the ravine against 119 south, two whole 100x100 m cells holding four and eight objects, and a flat olive stretch between the dirt road and the highway with nothing to stand behind. §15 names the cure — 25-40 камней, 20-35 кустов, 10-15 брёвен, 8-12 заборов, 5-8 остовов, опоры ЛЭП, 2-3 техстроения, 'крупные формы, не сотни мелочи' — and only the ACTIVE north (west of the closure at x -6100) is filled: 60 more actors of scenery behind a treeline is budget spent on a frame nobody stands in. Eleven clumps of six to eight, because a uniform sprinkle reads as noise from above and gives cover nowhere; each clump is something to move BETWEEN and the gaps between them are the exposure. Conventions: rock z 65, bush z 45, log z 55, fence_section z 92, car_wreck z 75, pylon z 0 (composite).
Clump B — beside the dirt road, so the road has a shoulder rather than an edge.
Clump C — the old field boundary on the дачи's ground (ТЗ §8's N01-N03 are Stage D).
Clump D — the north-east of the active third, on the way to nothing, which is why it needs a reason to be crossed.
Clump E — the eastern approach to the closure.
Clump F — the middle of the flat olive stretch the overview keeps showing as nothing.
Clump G — the ravine's northern shoulder, where a player walking the rim needs cover from the far bank.
Clump H — the south-west shoulder, on the line between the dirt road and the pipe crossing. Also the clump that lifts the 100x100 m cell at (-20000,+2200) off ТЗ §32's floor: it held four objects.
Clump I — the north edge east of E1, so the last 100 m before the extraction is not a sprint across a lawn.

Clump J — around техстроение B, which needs something around it or it reads as a crate in a field. Every one of these is outside the shed's footprint (x -9100..-8100, y 13200..14000), which Sarko.Map.BridgePropsClearTheWalls is the check for.
SPAWN CAMP SOFTENING — the camp itself was authored as a fence and three crates on bare ground; these give the first thirty seconds of every raid something to look at.
Two singles that fix the cell counts rather than a clump: one boulder on the road's east side, one field boundary north of the дачи ground.

ЛЭП (ТЗ §8), опоры 1 and 2 of the three in the active third — on the line (-11000,+19000) -> (+4000,+8500), i.e. y = 19000 - 0.7*(x+11000). The third is at (-8200,+17040), authored with the closure. Composite: pos.z = 0. Yaw 55 on both, matching the third: the crossarms have to sit perpendicular to the line the wires run along, and the same yaw turns the two legs off the player's east-west axis so both are visible instead of one hiding the other. The 'упавшая' one §8 asks for is on the closed stretch of the line and could not be built anyway — FSarkoPropPart has no roll.

THE PIPE CROSSING, south side — L01's sibling vocabulary: a trailer in the техдвор, barriers along the walkway's mouth, and enough scatter that the crossing's exit is not a bare gap. The eight standing pipes and the walkway between them are Stage B's and do not move.

THE PIPE CROSSING, north side — the approach L13 sits on. A sign at the head of the walkway, because from the north the crossing is a gap between two grey cylinders and nothing says 'this is a way across'.

THE RAIL DEPOT — the разгрузка. A trailer backed onto the dock pad, pallets as crates, and the упор at the west end that L30 stands against. The trailer moved 700 uu east and 50 north of the first draft: turned across the dock at (-15800,-16200) its tow bar — 180 uu of it, hanging off the body's -X face — closed over L26 at (-15800,-16600), and a container inside a solid prop is loot nobody can open. At (-15100,-16150) the bar's south end stops 120 uu short of the warehouse's north wall and the body's north end 50 uu short of the freight car.
The паллеты, moved with the trailer. The second was at (-15250,-16750), which put its southern half inside the warehouse's own north wall.

containers.note: SPAWN CAMP (ТЗ §29 L01-L03) — the three junk containers, and the tutorial's first lesson: a container opens, and this one holds scrap. fixedItems is only consulted while the profile says tutorial_completed is false; afterwards it is dead data and every container rolls. §29 has L13/L18/L25/L30 as junk too, but the owner's Bridge_West split is 3 junk, so junk is exactly the spawn camp: the first container the player ever opens teaches the interaction and holds nothing worth dying for.
L02 'дерево'. There is no tree kind and cannot be one (a canopy hides the player from a top-down camera), so this stands beside a treeline clump — see the flag list.
L03 'остов', shifted +100,+100 from §29's (-15100,+16600) so it stands 153 uu clear of the wreck's face rather than 53 — ТЗ §29 wants 120 uu free in front of a container.
THE PIPE CROSSING (L13, L18, L19) — the route starts paying. Re-tiered junk -> common per the owner's split. L13 is the north approach, L18 the pipe base.

THE MEDKIT, and the reason it is here: spec §6.5 teaches healing BEFORE the first bot, and the first bot stands on the АЗС forecourt 2900 uu south of this техдвор. A common container may hold базовая медицина (ТЗ §30), so the tier does not have to move for the beat to land.

THE GAS STATION (L20-L25) — buildings hold loot. L20 is the зал, inside the walkable bridge_gas_station: a container you have to walk into a building for is the whole point of the building, and twenty rounds is a reload before the forecourt.

L21, подсобка — the west room, 285 uu clear of both interior walls. THE FIRST VALUABLE: a toolbox, the first thing in the raid worth carrying home rather than using, which is the whole extraction loop in one object.
L22, shifted +200 in y from §29's (-13000,-9800), which is 50 uu OUTSIDE the building's south wall. It is now at the south end of the зал.
L23, стойка, the sector's only med container. Shifted 50 west of §29's (-12500,-8400) so it stands 120 uu off the east wall's inner face rather than 70 — ТЗ §29 wants 80.
L24, фургон — beside the trailer Task 4 authors at (-15000,-7950).
L25, inside сарай S02 (Task 4). Re-tiered junk -> common.
THE RAIL DEPOT (L26-L30) — deeper is richer, and the only place with military. L26 is the разгрузка pad, north of the warehouse.
L29, паллеты, inside the warehouse's east room (Task 4). Re-tiered common -> good.

THE MILITARY BEAT — no ledger row. ТЗ §29 puts no military west of the bridge (its four are the КПП and the промзона, all behind the closure), and the owner's Bridge_West split asks for two. They are here, at the deepest point of the route, and they retire when §29's four arrive with Stage D. This one is inside the warehouse's west room, past a doorway and a divider: a pistol and forty rounds, the richest single container in the sector.

The second, beside the вагон at the depot's east end — the furthest point from E1, which is what makes carrying it home a decision. Whatever the player takes from here they carry 37000 uu back to E1 past four bots, which is the lesson the whole map exists to teach.

playerSpawns.note: ТЗ §8's four, verbatim. One is chosen per raid. All four sit behind the broken fence at the north-west corner, facing south-east into the sector, and clear of every block — including Task 2's north and west world border, which starts at y = +19700 and x = -19700.

botSpawns.note: THE GAS STATION — two, per the owner's split. §11's АЗС парковка, verbatim.

§11's АЗС двор (-15000,-10500) shifted +400,-200 — the ledger point is exactly on сарай S02's east wall centre line, and a bot spawned inside a wall is the oldest bug on this map. §11 allows +/-300-800.
THE RAIL DEPOT — four, per the owner's split. These two are §11's ж/д запад and ж/д разгрузка, verbatim.

The two the owner's count adds beyond §11's west entries. Placed at the depot's own sub-areas and spaced so no two of the six can hear one shot: the closest pair on this map is rail_dock and rail_dispatcher at 2052 uu, against an 1800 uu hearing radius.

Shifted 400 south of the plan's (-12400,-15600): that point is INSIDE the freight car at (-12300,-15600), whose body is 1400 x 300 uu — a bot spawned inside a solid prop is the same bug the gas_yard note above is about, and no map test sees it because the invariants check blocks and building walls, not props. At y = -16000 it stands 250 uu clear of the car's south face, on the диспетчерская side of the train beside L28. §11 allows +/-300-800.

extractions.note: E1 (ТЗ §12), the pipes route, and the only extraction a Bridge_West player can reach. §12's trigger is ~1000x700; a 500 uu radius is the round equivalent. Task 2's north border leaves a 1200 uu mouth at exactly this x so E1 is the one gap in the treeline — the way out of the world.
